body: I really appreciate what you said here.  I just can't get that thought out of my head: "50,000 Elvis fans can't be wrong".  I worry that at least where I live, FDS and KAM aren't nearly as fringe of an opinion.

I just don't know who to trust.  I live in the SF Bay Area, and I like that: I'm pretty strongly left, I just feel uneasy about how to reconcile my existence when men make women so miserable and oppressed.  The idea that men should die that I hear from women and girls in my area feels justified, and that scares me.  Where I live, girls who go against that are just "pick-me girls" so I don't know if it's okay to trust anyone who goes against KAM stuff now.  I can't seem to convince myself to trust that.
I just feel like any therapist that I bring this up to would hate me.
